items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: This is Professor Pitchback Two-Row... He's the conductor of the band.

ctx.x: Sit down, sir. We can... You'll be more comfortable.

Now, I'll point out to a fellow. This is Professor Pitchback Two-Row. Oh, yes. Standing up. He's the conductor of the band. The baton on the left. That's right. Uh-huh. And the other fellow sitting here, the first row, this is... This is the one I was telling you about, Son Johnson. Oh, yes. That's the sax. That's the sax, Son Johnson. This is little Eddie Johnson. We call him Yellow Eddie because they had two Eddie Johnson.
I see. One is Big Head, is it?
